Thank you for reaching out to the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. We understand how stressful it is when your plans are disrupted, especially when you are traveling with Finn. From your message, it sounds like you believe you were affected by a missed connection and a delayed departure, and you want the trip handled correctly and fairly.

<<FACT F116>> 

<<FACT F109>> 

First, we’re sorry for the inconvenience and the worry this caused for you and Finn. Our aim is to treat every journey as a shared responsibility, so when something goes off schedule, we expect the right communication and timely coordination so companion animals can travel with care.

Here is what we can do right away. Please keep any boarding passes, confirmation emails, and baggage or pet documentation you already have, since those items help our team verify the timeline and the sequence of events. If you noted any specific contact attempts at the airport or any crew updates you received, include those details as well. Our escalation process is calm and stepwise, which means your case is reviewed carefully: first the incident notes and routing, then the operational records, and finally the claim eligibility details. When we involve the crew documentation, the goal is clarity rather than delay.

If your situation also involved ground handling or boarding adjustments for Finn, that matters too. The department shares practical guidance with crews to support companion animal travel, but disruptions can still create complications. We want to confirm that the standard support steps were followed and that you were given the correct information during the disruption.

If you would like, you can also name the travelers you are writing on behalf of (for example, Rafael Dubois or Eva Romano), and indicate what assistance would have made the biggest difference during the connection window. That helps us place your experience in context while we review the records. We will also confirm the next steps for processing your request and keep you updated in a straightforward way.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
